description: One child has an anaesthetic with a recorded start and no recorded stop, two blood pressures on its record, one half an hour and one three hours after the start, and an infusion started during it.

expectations.says: The anaesthesia layer writes the anaesthetic as a visit detail whose end datetime is empty and whose end date is the date of its start, because the model requires an end date.
expectations.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS visit_details, SUM(CASE WHEN vd.visit_detail_end_datetime IS NULL AND vd.visit_detail_end_date = vd.visit_detail_start_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS open_ended FROM omop.visit_detail vd WHERE vd.visit_detail_source_value = '990000531'

expectations.says: The anaesthetic's own procedure row has an empty end.
expectations.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS anaesthetics FROM omop.procedure_occurrence po JOIN omop.visit_detail vd ON vd.visit_detail_id = po.visit_detail_id WHERE vd.visit_detail_source_value = '990000531' AND po.procedure_source_value = 'ANAESTHETIC' AND po.procedure_end_date IS NULL AND po.procedure_end_datetime IS NULL

expectations.says: The anaesthetic table holds the anaesthetic with an empty end and an empty duration, and its whole phase has an empty end.
expectations.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS anaesthetics FROM omop.anaesthetic a JOIN omop.visit_detail vd ON vd.visit_detail_id = a.visit_detail_id JOIN omop.anaesthetic_phase ph ON ph.anaesthetic_id = a.anaesthetic_id WHERE vd.visit_detail_source_value = '990000531' AND a.end_datetime IS NULL AND a.duration_minutes IS NULL AND ph.phase_name = 'whole anaesthetic' AND ph.end_datetime IS NULL

expectations.says: Both systolic readings point at the anaesthetic, because an anaesthetic without a stop has no upper end to the window in which a reading points at it.
expectations.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS readings FROM omop.measurement m JOIN omop.anaesthetic a ON a.anaesthetic_id = m.measurement_event_id JOIN omop.visit_detail vd ON vd.visit_detail_id = a.visit_detail_id WHERE vd.visit_detail_source_value = '990000531' AND m.measurement_concept_id = 3004249

expectations.says: The infusion belongs to the anaesthetic's visit detail.
expectations.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS periods FROM omop.drug_exposure d JOIN omop.visit_detail vd ON vd.visit_detail_id = d.visit_detail_id WHERE vd.visit_detail_source_value = '990000531'
